name: Domenico J Bruno
tagline: Analog IC design for low-power biopotential sensing.
intro: Analog IC design for low-power biopotential sensing. Subthreshold OTAs, OTA-C filters and nanoampere references in 180 nm CMOS — circuits that pull microvolt signals off the human body without draining the battery.
summary: Low-power analog/mixed-signal IC designer with experience in CMOS front-ends for biopotential and physiological sensing, seeking hands-on industry experience in analog front-end design and verification.
